Public Health Engineering Dept, Odisha 
 Office of the Executive Engineer · Odisha · IN 
 
 No. CC/57/2020/006 
 Dated: 31/03/2026 
 
 CERTIFICATE OF COMPLETION OF WORK 
 This is to certify that the work of "Lift Irrigation - Odisha Pkg-6" (irrigation), awarded to M/s
 National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. (GSTIN 19NAICC4417O1Z1, PAN NAICC4417O) , has been
 completed in all respects on 07/02/2020 at a gross executed value of Rs. 2431.00 Lakh (Rupees
 24.31 Crore Only). 
 
 On joint measurement and final inspection, the executed quantities were found in order and the
 workmanship conforming to the technical specifications forming part of the contract.
 The work was supervised on the contractor's side by Jaya Desai. This certificate is issued for record
 and for submission with future tenders wherever the contractor is required to establish past
 performance. 
 
 
 
 Executive Engineer 
 Public Health Engineering Dept, Odisha
